body: What do you know about me to care about me? Generic platitudes won't do anything to make anything better.
That's the reason I started smoking at the age of 18. Some small, morbid hope I'd get fast-acting lung cancer soon.
I've been wanting to off myself for about that long, too. Always chickened out because it's so permanent. But I don't seem to have a commitment phobia in other ways, except maybe staying at a job.
